snippet.title: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth | Cozy Quest 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
NEW TRAILER | Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth is a story-driven, cozy puzzle adventure game where you play as Moomintroll. Wander through a snow-covered Moominvalley, and embark on a whimsical a journey into the unknown on your quest for warmth and friendship. If you’re eager for more updates, don’t forget to wishlist the game!

While not a direct sequel to our previous game, Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley, it is a spiritual successor with many similarities! You can enjoy both games on their own, and in any order you’d like 💙

Learn more & wishlist:
https://www.moomintroll.game/
